title: Detect authentication failure bursts
prompt: Implement solve(payload) with positive integer window_s and threshold, plus events sorted by nondecreasing time. Each event has integer time>=0, user (string), and outcome "failure" or "success". Per user, track failures in the half-open window (time-window_s, time], so failures exactly window_s old expire. A success clears that user's history. On each failure, prune expired failures, measure the count before adding this failure, then add it. Emit an alert only when the count crosses from below threshold to at least threshold. This can happen again after expiry or a success; continuing failures above threshold do not repeatedly alert. Return {"alerts":[{"user":user,"time":time,"count":new_count},...]} in event order. Equal timestamps are separate events. Invalid window_s<=0 or threshold<=0 returns {"error":"invalid_policy"} before processing. Other fields and ordering are valid. Do not mutate input.
